title: Chat: HD26 Line List — Conflicted Copy and Duplicate Code

fields.topic: Heritage Days supper GI cluster: interviews, line list, call-backs

messages.text: Sorry, sorry. The line list threw an error when I hit save: "The file is locked for editing by another user. Changes saved to a conflicted copy." Now I'm in HD26_Supper_LineList (Marisol Tran's conflicted copy).xlsx. It has four interview rows that aren't in the master.
I checked them against the master. Three of them are people who are already on there under ED codes. They match on age, table and onset, so they duplicate rows you already have.
The fourth one is new, but I coded her HD26-015, and 015 had already gone to an ED case. So now there are two HD26-015s with different onsets: one Sun 05:30, one Sun 11:00.
Also, I typed first names in the notes column on two of my rows so I could call them back. They're still in the conflicted copy.
Should I just keep my copy going? Two other interviewers are asking for edit rights too. I'm coming to your door now with the laptop.

instructorNote: This inject adds friction to the line list. Look for the Epidemiology Lead to freeze the conflicted copy and keep the master as the only count. Check the three duplicates against the master and drop them, and recode the new case as HD26-018. Only the Epi Lead and backup Dev Kulkarni should have edit rights, so interviewers send their forms in for entry. The Nurse Manager should take the first names out of the sheet, move them to the key file and remind interviewers that names never go in the sheet.
